content.title: Sept. jobs report, Walmart earnings, Fedspeak: What to Watch
content.description:
Asking for a Trend host Josh Lipton previews several of the biggest stories to come tomorrow, Thursday, November 20, including the release of September's jobs report that was long-delayed due to the US government shutdown; earnings results from companies like Walmart (WMT), Intuit (INTU), and Ross Stores (ROST); and commentary from a handful of Federal Reserve officials.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Asking for a Trend.
